notes.subject: מראה
notes.rationale: Word appears only here in the Tanakh; glossed as rebellious from the root מרה, and the city's rebellion is set against the lashing she gives herself

notes.subject: היונה
notes.rationale: From the root ינה to oppress; the consonants spell the name Yonah, a resonance lost in Bambara

notes.subject: hadamadenw
notes.rationale: The Hebrew participle oppressing-her implies the object; Bambara needs the explicit object hadamadenw

translation: Juguya! O de ye dugu ye min bunbali ani min jɔgɔya — dugu min bɛ hadamadenw ɲagami!
